propositions: Compaction must work in environments with no CI and no local cron, requiring a floor trigger beyond the scheduled sweep that works everywhere without holding the store lock across blocking operations.
The selection logic for compact-all must cover both backfill (tickets without snapshots) and recurrence (tickets over threshold), ensuring convergence after a fold without churning.

The scheduled sweep runs a 6-hourly GitHub Actions workflow that re-derives the store from origin/tickets on a disposable runner, avoiding accumulation and reusing existing reconcile-bridge infrastructure.

A detached worker spawned from the close path after lock release performs out-of-band compaction via the same stamped advisory lock mechanism as enrich_drain, preventing multiple concurrent compactors and skipping when the store lock is held by writers.

Honest sweep counting observes snapshot artifacts before and after instead of relying on return codes, and a dry run must never push or stamp the sweep clock to avoid masking failures and suppressing staleness detection.
